text: Appeal of Order to Comply (April 26, 2018) for 730 Dovercourt Road

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated April 26, 2018, regarding the property located at 730 Dovercourt Road, Folder No. 18 148896 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to September 1, 2018.
